stages.name: Intake
stages.when: A GitHub issue arrives on a connected repository.

prompts.name: Issue proposal
prompts.whenRuns: When someone opens a GitHub issue on a connected repository, ShipLean starts an intake round. This is the agent’s session prompt: it restates the request, checks what already exists and posts a proposal on the issue.
prompts.readBy: The intake agent, working in a read-only checkout
prompts.note: Replaces the Proposal instructions box under Integrations. Its output is public, so keep the “Public text only” rules.
prompts.builtInText:
# issueProposal

Short built-in text for issueProposal.
Second line.

custom.text: Write a proposal for this issue to the project's standards. Public text only.
custom.baseText:
# issueProposal

Short built-in text for issueProposal.
Second line.

stages.name: Shape
stages.when: An idea or research question might become work.

prompts.name: Work from idea to done
prompts.whenRuns: The first thing an agent reads when it gets an idea or a research question: find or create a Proposed Feature, put findings on it, and end with comment and set_status.
prompts.readBy: Any agent, at the start of a session

stages.name: Plan
stages.when: A Feature or Epic is broken down into stories and tasks.

prompts.name: Planning and breakdown
prompts.whenRuns: Read before breaking a Feature or Epic down, whatever its size. It picks the mode (Direct, orchestrator or conductor), shapes waves and contracts, and walks the run through to the retro.

stages.name: Build
stages.when: Each wave runs: leads and implementers pick up their briefs.

prompts.name: Lead brief
prompts.whenRuns: In conductor mode, each lane lead gets this when it calls get_brief on its story. It launches sub-agents, runs reviews and keeps the plan current; it never touches code.

prompts.name: Task brief

stages.name: Review
stages.when: Each task’s commits are reviewed, then fixed.

prompts.name: Code reviewer
prompts.whenRuns: After an implementer reports, a reviewer reads only that task’s commits on the shared branch, comments Review · and calls log_review.
prompts.readBy: A reviewer from a different model family
prompts.builtInText:
# codeReviewer

Short built-in text for codeReviewer.
Second line.

prompts.name: Fix round
prompts.whenRuns: When log_review says changes_requested: fix each blocking finding with new commits, never amend or force-push, then report again.
prompts.readBy: The implementer, after changes are requested
prompts.builtInText:
# fix

Short built-in text for fix.
Second line.

stages.name: Retro
stages.when: The plan run ends and the conductor writes up what happened.

prompts.name: Run retro
prompts.whenRuns: The template for the run retro: budget, timeline table, what slowed it down. It feeds log_retrospective and, with SHIP-568, the project’s Ways of working.
prompts.readBy: The conductor, at the end of the run
prompts.builtInText:
# retro

prompts.name: Retro analysis
prompts.whenRuns: An agent is asked to analyse retrospective points across a project, a sprint or a Feature. The method turns repeated points into ranked fixes.
